title: 第十七章 丰厚报酬新书求月票求追读第十八章 踏上修行路
slug: 从效法万妖开始成就真仙
lines: 砰！砰！
旁边漆黑安静的屋子里，突然响起重物砸地的声音。
然后是惊恐的呜咽。
显然里面的人被吓得不轻。
林舒孤身立于黑漆漆的长巷。
眼眸里掠过一丝疲惫。
并非是力竭后的虚弱，而是生命力被迅速抽离带来的不适。
他垂眸看向指尖，黑气缓缓消散。
相比起先前对付刘老三使用的辉月爪术，仅是汇聚出几道流光，这次使出的仙法，杀伤力简直凶残了数倍不止。
其中不止有升了一品的原因。
林舒隐约能察觉到，自从投入恶钱以后，这仙法本身也在朝奇怪的方向发展。
当然，恐怖效果的代价就是，它的消耗远超预料。
那些原本在喂养白狼虚影，顺带维系林舒性命的雾气，此刻已经只剩不足三成。
林舒转身，在旁边的石阶坐下。
两侧横七竖八的堆满了尸体。
【杀人放火金腰带，修桥补路无尸骸，杀贱命一条，赏恶钱五文】
【生死自有天定，阎罗手中夺命，救烂命一条，赐善功一文】
关于恶钱和善功的提示同时密密麻麻跃起。
林舒几乎能听到钱币互相碰撞的声音。
瘦削男人价值五文，剩下那几个也不差，全都作价三文。
总共二十九枚漆黑铜板落入林舒袖口。
对于恶钱的数量，他倒是早有预料，毕竟这群人很明显要比刘老三强出许多，贵点才正常。
但整整二十条关于善功的提示，则是让林舒略感意外。
喜鹊窝里的窑姐，算上花姐和老杨，总共也就二十个人。
这是一个也没打算放过啊，鸡蛋都给你摇散黄了。
林舒双手撑地，目光扫过满地的尸首，摇了摇头，感慨道：“你们这也太狠了点儿。”
休息的差不多了。
他拍拍衣摆，慵懒朝着巷外看去：
“差爷，进来收尸了。”
破旧的红灯笼下，有人缓步走了出来。
依旧是那张黝黑的脸庞。
常奕神情复杂的看过来，刀鞘挎在腰间，手掌则是死死按在刀柄上。
其实他先前就到了。
随便找了个腹痛的借口，暂时摆脱前辈以后，便一刻不敢耽误的赶来了青柳巷。
常奕就靠在阴影里，亲眼看着秦云海一众武馆弟子进了这条巷子。
他只是在犹豫。
要在什么场景下，自己以何种理由出手，看上去才不像是收了钱来替狡狐堂撑腰的打手。

Bang! Bang!
In the dark and quiet room next to him, the sound of heavy objects hitting the ground suddenly sounded.
Then came the terrified whimpering.
The people inside were clearly frightened.
"..."
Lin Shu stood alone in the long dark alley.
There was a hint of exhaustion in his eyes.
It's not the weakness after exhaustion, but the discomfort caused by the rapid withdrawal of life force.
He lowered his eyes and looked at his fingertips, and the black energy slowly dissipated.
Compared with the glowing moon claw technique used against Liu Laosan before, which only produced a few streams of light, the lethality of the magical technique used this time was several times more brutal.
There are more than one reasons for being promoted to the first level.
Lin Shu could vaguely sense that since the bad money was invested, the magic itself was also developing in a strange direction.
Of course, the price of the terrifying effect is that it consumes far more than expected.
The mist that was originally feeding the white wolf's shadow and sustaining Lin Shu's life now had less than 30% left.
"Tsk."
Lin Shu turned around and sat down on the stone steps next to him.
Both sides were piled with corpses.
[Gold belt for murder and arson, no corpses for repairing bridges and repairing roads, one life for killing a lowly person, five coins for reward]
[Life and death are determined by God. A life is taken in the hands of Yama, a life is saved, and a good deed is bestowed]
Reminders about bad money and good deeds pop up all at once.
Lin Shu could almost hear the sound of coins clanging against each other.
The thin man is worth five cents, and the remaining ones are not bad either, all priced at three cents.
A total of twenty-nine jet black copper plates fell into Lin Shu's sleeves.
He had already expected the amount of bad money. After all, this group of people was obviously much better than Liu Laosan, so it was normal for them to be more expensive.
But there were a total of twenty reminders about good deeds, which slightly surprised Lin Shu.
There are only twenty sisters in the magpie nest, including Sister Hua and Lao Yang.
I don't plan to let any of them go. The eggs have been shaken for you until they turn yellow.
Lin Shu put his hands on the ground and glanced at the corpses on the ground. He shook his head and sighed: "You are too cruel."
It's almost time to rest.
He patted the hem of his clothes and looked lazily out of the alley:
"Master, come in and collect the body."
"..."
Under the dilapidated red lantern, someone walked out slowly.
Still the same dark face.
Chang Yi looked over with a complicated expression. The scabbard was hung on his waist, and his palm was firmly pressed on the handle of the knife.
In fact, he had arrived earlier.
I casually made an excuse for abdominal pain, and after temporarily getting rid of my senior, I rushed to Qingliu Lane without any delay.
Chang Yi leaned in the shadow and watched Qin Yunhai and his martial arts disciples enter the alley.
He was just hesitating.
Under what circumstances and for what reasons should I take action so that I don't look like a thug who has been paid to support Cunning Fox Hall.
